931: That Creator gives mind and body;
that Creator is in every mind and mouth.
God is the Life of the world; there is no other.
Nanak, dyed in the Name, one is honoured. ॥9॥
Rara: one who lovingly remembers the Sovereign Lord
fights in the battlefield of life, having conquered his mind;
night and day he stays dyed in the Lord's love,
and comes to know the One known in the three worlds and the four ages.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
One who knows Him becomes like Him;
he becomes utterly pure, and his body is fulfilled.
The Blissful Lord dwells in his heart with single-minded love;
the Word is within him, and he is attuned to the True One. ॥10॥
ਰੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ; ਰਹਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Do not be angry; drink the nectar; there is no staying forever in this world.
ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ ਰੰਕ. ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ; ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Kings, nobles and paupers will not remain; they come and go through the four ages.
ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਤੇ. ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ॥
No one remains by saying they will stay; to whom should I pray for that?
ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੋਧਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
The One Word of the Lord's Name protects from vice; the Guru gives honour and understanding. ॥11॥
ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ; ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਲਿ ਚਲੀ ॥
Her shyness of the world has died away; she walks with her veil lifted.
ਸਾਸੁ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਬਾਵਰੀ; ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਸੰਕ ਟਲੀ ॥
The fear of her mad, crazed mother-in-law, Maya, has been lifted from her head.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਰਲੀ ਸਿਉ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Her Beloved calls her with love and delight; the Word is in her mind, and bliss.
ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ. ਲਾਲੀ ਭਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਚਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੨॥
Dyed in the Beloved's love, she glows red; turning to the Guru, she is free of care. ॥12॥
Lalla: chant the jewel of the Name, the excellent profit.
Craving, greed and ego are evil;
slander, flattery and backbiting are evil.
The self-willed is blind, foolish and ignorant.
He came into the world to earn a profit,
but became a slave labourer and went away cheated by the cheat, Maya.
One who earns the profit of the Name with the capital of faith,
Nanak, receives true honour from the True King. ॥13॥
Coming into the world, people are ruined and take the path of Death;
no one is able to erase the craving for Maya that has come over them.
If great wealth is in a lowly man's house,
seeing the wealth, rich and poor alike bow to him;
with wealth, even a fool is thought wise.
Without devotion the world has gone mad.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
to the one on whom He shows grace, He is revealed. ॥14॥
Through the ages He establishes the creation and remains ever without enmity;
He is not subject to birth and death, nor to worldly entanglement.
Whatever is seen is He Himself;
He Himself creates, and Himself fashions all beings.
He Himself is beyond the senses; the world is caught in its affairs.
He, the Life of the world, is Himself the way of union.
Make remembrance of the True One your conduct, and there will be peace;
without the Name, how can there be liberation? ॥15॥
Without the Name, the body is at war with itself.
ਕਿਉ. ਨ ਮਿਲਹਿ; ਕਾਟਹਿ ਮਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
Why not meet the Lord and remove the pain of your mind?
The traveller comes and goes on the road;
ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਇਆ; ਕਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
what did he bring, and what has he gained?
Without the Name there is loss everywhere;
the profit is gained when the Lord gives understanding.
The trader deals in other merchandise;
without the Name, how can he be honoured? ॥16॥
One who reflects on the Lord's virtues is spiritually wise;
through His virtues spiritual wisdom is obtained.
Rare in the world is one who imparts His virtues;
the true way of life comes through reflecting on the Guru's teaching.
The Lord is unreachable and beyond the senses; His worth cannot be found.
932: We meet Him only when He unites us with Himself.
The virtuous bride ever cherishes His virtues;
Nanak, through the Guru's teaching the Friend is met. ॥17॥
Lust and anger waste away the body,
The gold is tested on the touchstone and bears the fire;
then, of beautiful colour, it is approved in the assayer's sight.
The world is a beast in its ego, and Death is the butcher.
The Creator made the creation and decreed that each receives the fruit of its deeds.
The One who made it alone knows its worth;
ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
what else can be said? Nothing can be said. ॥18॥
Khakha: searching and searching, he drank the nectar;
he took up forgiveness and gave his mind to the True Guru.
he is a genuine jewel through the four ages.
Those who just eat and drink die without knowing Him;
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੂਏ; ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
when they recognise the Word, they die to the self in an instant.
Their mind becomes steady, content to die to the self;
by the Guru's grace they recognise the Name. ॥19॥
Gagga: the Lord is all-pervading and profound; one whose mind dwells in Him,
singing His praises, dwells in peace and poise.
ਗਇਆ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not come and go again in birth and death;
by the Guru's grace he remains attuned to Him.
The all-pervading Lord is unreachable, without master, unborn.
Attention fixed on Him makes the mind steady and brings forth virtue.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵਹਿ. ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
Remember the Lord's Name and you will not fall into births again.
The Guru's teaching is the most excellent; all other teachings are without the Name. ॥20॥
Ghagha: the soul has grown weary wandering through countless homes and doors;
its births are countless, without end.
So many mothers, fathers, sons and daughters it has had;
so many gurus and disciples it has been.
ਕਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
Through a false guru, no one is liberated.
There are so many brides; the One Husband cares for them all.
The one who turns to the Guru lives and dies with God.
ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਢੂਢਿ; ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.
Union came about; the True Guru brought it about. ॥21॥
The one turned to the Guru sings and speaks His praises;
the one turned to the Guru weighs the Name and inspires others to weigh it.
The one turned to the Guru comes and goes free of bonds,
having cast off filth and burnt away the stain of vice.
For the one turned to the Guru, reflection is music and Vedas;
for the one turned to the Guru, good conduct is the cleansing bath.
For the one turned to the Guru, the Word is the most excellent nectar;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru reaches the far shore. ॥22॥
Chachcha: the fickle mind does not stay in one place;
the deer of the mind stealthily nibbles the tender shoots of pleasure.
One who enshrines the lotus feet in the heart and mind
lives long, ever aware and alert.
Everyone is seen to be anxious;
where the One is remembered, there is peace.
One in whose mind the Lord dwells, absorbed in the Lord's Name,
ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
is liberated and goes home with honour. ॥23॥
Chhachha: when the knot of the breath comes undone, the body wastes away;
wander the world and see this destruction daily.
ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ; ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
If one regards sunshine and shade, pleasure and pain, as alike,
he cuts his bonds and brings liberation home.
The world is beguiled by the hollow shadow of Maya;
the record of past deeds is written from the beginning.
Youth wastes away, old age comes, and Death hovers over the head;
933: the body wastes away and sags like water-weed. ॥24॥
Jajja: God Himself is manifest in the three worlds;
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਚਾਂਪੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Death does not crush one who sings the Lord's praises;
ਪਾਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥

Nyanya: He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom and Himself understands it;
He Himself comprehends it and Himself perceives it.
Those in whose heart the Guru's teaching is absorbed

The Guru is an ocean; there is no lack of jewels in him;
he is an inexhaustible store of rubies, the form of the True One.
Do the deeds the Guru has told you;

Nanak, through the Guru's teaching, merge in the True One. ॥27॥
Tatta: love breaks when one speaks bluntly;
the arm breaks when pulled from both sides;
the husband leaves the evil-minded wife.
The knot is untied by good reflection;
through the Guru's Word, accomplish your work within your own home.
Then one earns the true profit, and there is no loss;
the Beloved, the great Master of the three worlds, is one's helper. ॥28॥
Thattha: restrain your mind and keep it in its place.
The world is destroyed fighting, regretting its faults.
There is One Lord and Master; all are His brides.
The false bride puts on many disguises.

Adorned with the Word, she loves the True One;

ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ; ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥

One who gave his mind to his Guru obtained the immaculate Name.

ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ; ਧਨੁ ਕਾਚਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
People hoard gold and silver, but this wealth is false, poison and ashes.
ਸਾਹੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Hoarding wealth he calls himself a banker, but is ruined by duality.
ਸਚਿਆਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ; ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
The truthful gather the Truth; the True Name is priceless.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਊਜਲੋ; ਪਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
The Lord is immaculate and pure; through Him they have true honour and true speech.
ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂ; ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
O Lord, You are my wise friend and companion; You are the pool and You the swan.
ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the one in whose mind the True Master dwells.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know the One who made the enticing attachment to Maya.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੮॥
Poison and nectar come from the One; the wise being understands this. ॥48॥
ਖਿਮਾ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ; ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
Khakha: without forgiveness, countless hundreds of thousands have perished.
ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਕਿਉ ਗਣੀ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਸੰਖ ॥
They cannot be counted; how can I count them? Countless have wasted away and died.
ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ; ਖੂਲੈ. ਬੰਧੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
One who recognises his Master is set free, and is not bound again.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਰਾ ਤੂ; ਖਿਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
Through the Word he dwells in the Lord's mansion; You, O Lord, are revealed to him, and forgiveness, truth and peace come with ease.
ਖਰਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੂ; ਆਪੇ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
You are his provisions, his true wealth and his meditation; You Yourself dwell in his body.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਦਾ; ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
With mind, body and mouth he ever chants Your Name; virtue is within him, and his mind is steady.
ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪੈ ਖਪਾਇਸੀ; ਬੀਜਉ ਵਥੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Ego wastes away and wastes others; everything else is corruption.
ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੪੯॥
The Creator created beings and placed ego within them, yet He remains detached and infinite. ॥49॥
Sassa: no one knows the secret of the Creator of the world;
whatever the Creator does surely comes to pass.
For the sake of wealth, people meditate on God,
and wealth is obtained according to past destiny.
For the sake of wealth, people become servants and thieves;
but wealth does not go along; it becomes someone else's.
Without the True One, there is no honour in His Court.
One who drinks the Lord's essence is saved in the end. ॥50॥
ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ; ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
Haha: O friend, looking and looking, I am wonderstruck;
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਮੈ ਮੁਈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
the self that cried "I, I" has died; through the Word my mind has come to know Him.
ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਘਣੇ; ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
I wore myself out adorning myself with necklaces, ribbons and many bracelets;
ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
meeting the Beloved I found peace; the necklace of all His virtues is around my neck.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Nanak, through the Guru, love and affection for the Lord are found.
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Without the Lord, who has found peace? Reflect in your mind and see.
ਹਰਿ ਪੜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Read of the Lord, understand the Lord, and keep your love for the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫੧॥
Chant the Lord, meditate on the Lord, and make the Lord's Name your support. ॥51॥
ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ; ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
O friend, the record the Creator has written cannot be erased.
ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
The One who made the cause, showing mercy, comes to dwell within.
ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Glory is in the Creator's hands; understand this by reflecting on the Guru's Word.
ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫੇਰਿ. ਨ ਸਕੀਐ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
What is written cannot be changed; O Lord, care for us as You please.
ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Nanak, reflecting on the Word I have found peace by Your gracious glance.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
The self-willed go astray and rot away; those who reflect on the Guru's Word are saved.
ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
What can be said of the Lord who cannot be seen?
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has shown Him to me in my own heart. ॥52॥
ਪਾਧਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ; ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Paa: that pandit is called learned who, through his learning, lives with a natural poise;
938: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
who reflects on his learning, finds the essence, and is attuned to the Lord's Name.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ. ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਦਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
The self-willed sells his learning; he earns poison and eats poison.
ਮੂਰਖੁ. ਸਬਦੁ, ਨ ਚੀਨਈ; ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ. ਨਹ ਕਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
The fool does not recognise the Word; he has no understanding at all. ॥53॥
ਪਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
That pandit is called one turned to the Guru who gives his pupils this teaching:
ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰਹੁ; ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
"Dwell on the Name, gather the Name, and earn the profit in this world."
ਸਚੀ ਪਟੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ; ਪੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ, ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
With the True One in the mind as the true writing-board, study the Word, the most excellent.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫੪॥੧॥
Nanak, he alone is learned, he alone is a wise pandit, who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name. ॥54॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਿਧ ਸਭਾ, ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ॥
The siddhas form their assembly and sit in their postures; hail to the assembly of the saints.
ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਸਾਚਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
I offer my prayer before it, where the True, infinite, boundless Lord dwells.
ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
I would cut off my head and place it before them, and offer my body and mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ, ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਉ ॥੧॥
Nanak, meeting the saints, the True One is found, and one sings His praises with ease. ॥1॥
What use is wandering? Purity comes only through the Truth.
ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the true Word, no one is liberated. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਵਨ ਤੁਮੇ. ਕਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ; ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ. ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਆਓ ॥
(Charpat:) "Who are you? What is your name? What is your way? What is its aim?"
ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਹਉ. ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਓ ॥
(Guru:) "I speak the Truth; this is my prayer; I am a sacrifice to the holy people."
ਕਹ ਬੈਸਹੁ. ਕਹ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਾਲੇ; ਕਹ ਆਵਹੁ. ਕਹ ਜਾਹੋ ॥
"Where do you sit? Where do you dwell, young man? Where do you come from, and where are you going?"
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ. ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਕਿਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਹੋ ॥੨॥
Nanak says: Charpat asked, "Listen, renunciant, what is your path?" ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬੈਸਿ. ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ; ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
(Guru:) "Dwelling in the Lord, who sits in every heart, we abide in Him; we walk in the True Guru's Will.
ਸਹਜੇ ਆਏ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਏ ॥
We came by His Command, and by His Command we go; Nanak is ever in His Will.
ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ; ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Our seat and abode is in the eternal Lord; such is the Guru's teaching I have received.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ. ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
The one turned to the Guru understands and recognises himself, and merges in the Truest of the true." ॥3॥
ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
(Charpat:) "The world-ocean is said to be impassable; how can one cross to the far shore?"
ਚਰਪਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ, ਅਉਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ; ਦੇਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Charpat says, "O Nanak, detached one, give us your true reflection."
ਆਪੇ ਆਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
(Guru:) "What answer can I give to one who himself speaks and himself understands?
ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ. ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ; ਤੁਝੁ. ਕਿਆ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
I speak the Truth: you have already crossed over; what argument can I give you?" ॥4॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ. ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ ॥
"As the lotus stays untouched in the water, and the duck floats on the stream,
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ. ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
so, with awareness fixed on the Word, one crosses the world-ocean; Nanak chants the Name.
ਰਹਹਿ ਇਕਾਂਤਿ. ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ॥
One who dwells in solitude, with the One in his mind, remains free of desire amid desire,
ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੫॥
and sees and shows the Unreachable, Unfathomable Lord — Nanak is his servant." ॥5॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਪੂਛਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
(Charpat:) "Hear my prayer, master; I ask for your true reflection.
ਰੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ, ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੋ ॥
Do not be angry; answer me: how is the Guru's door found?"
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤਉ. ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
(Guru:) "This restless mind settles in the true home, Nanak, with the Name as its support.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੬॥
The Creator Himself unites us in union, and we come to love the True One." ॥6॥
ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ; ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ॥
(Loharipa:) "We stay apart from shops and highways, in the wilderness among trees and plants.
ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਹਾਰੋ ਖਾਈਐ; ਅਉਧੂ ਬੋਲੈ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
We eat roots and fruits for food," said the yogi, speaking of his wisdom.
939: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
"We bathe at pilgrim places and obtain the fruit of peace; no filth clings to us."
ਗੋਰਖ ਪੂਤੁ. ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ ਬੋਲੈ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ. ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
Loharipa, disciple of Gorakh, says, "This is the way and method of yoga." ॥7॥
ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ. ਨੀਦ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ. ਨ ਡੋੁਲਾਈ ॥
(Guru:) "Amid shops and highways one should not fall asleep, nor let the mind waver toward another's home.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ, ਨ ਟਿਕਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੂਖ, ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Without the Name the mind finds no steady support; Nanak, its hunger does not go.
ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
The Guru has shown me the shop, the city and the home within, where I trade in Truth with ease.
ਖੰਡਿਤ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ. ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰੰ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥
Sleep little and eat little; Nanak, this is the essence of reflection." ॥8॥
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
(Yogis:) "Adopt the garb and sect of the yogis — earrings, wallet and patched coat.
ਬਾਰਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ; ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
Among the twelve orders, follow ours; among the six schools, ours is the one path.
ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਚੋਟ. ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
In this way the mind is instructed, O man, and one does not suffer blows again."
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
Nanak says: the one turned to the Guru understands; this is how the way of yoga is found. ॥9॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Let the Word within, unbroken, be your earrings; remove ego and possessiveness.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸੁ ਸਮਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
Cast off lust, anger and pride; through the Guru's Word comes true understanding.
ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
Seeing the Lord pervading all is the patched coat and wallet; Nanak, the One Lord carries us across.
ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ; ਪਰਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
True is the Master, true His glory; examine and test the Guru's genuine word. ॥10॥
Let the mind turned away from the world be your begging bowl, and the virtues of the five elements your cap;
let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loincloth;
let truth, contentment and self-restraint be your companions.
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru dwells on the Name. ॥11॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ; ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Who is united, within and without?
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ; ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Who is absorbed in the Lord of the three worlds?" ॥12॥
(Guru:) "He is hidden in every heart; the one turned to the Guru is liberated.
Through the Word one is united, within and without.
The self-willed perishes, and comes and goes;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru merges in the True One." ॥13॥
(Siddhas:) "How is one bound and devoured by the serpent?
ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
How does one lose, and how does one gain?
ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
How does one become pure, and how is there darkness?
ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ; ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
One who reflects on this essence is our guru." ॥14॥
(Guru:) "Bound by evil-mindedness, one is devoured by the serpent of Maya.
The self-willed loses; the one turned to the Guru gains.
Meeting the True Guru, the darkness departs;
Nanak, erasing ego, one merges in the Lord." ॥15॥
"If one builds an unbroken dam of attention on the still, absolute Lord,
ਉਡੈ ਨ. ਹੰਸਾ; ਪੜੈ ਨ. ਕੰਧੁ ॥
the swan of the mind does not fly away, and the wall of the body does not crumble.
One who knows the cave of poise to be his true home,
Nanak, becoming true, is pleasing to the True One." ॥16॥
(Siddhas:) "Why did you leave your home and become a wandering renunciant?
Why did you adopt this garb?
What merchandise do you trade in?
How will you carry your company across?" ॥17॥
(Guru:) "I became a wanderer to search for those turned to the Guru;
I adopted this garb to have their vision.
I trade in the merchandise of Truth;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru crosses over." ॥18॥
(Siddhas:) "O man, how have you changed the course of your life?
ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਝੁ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
To what have you attached your mind?
940: How have you consumed your hopes and desires?
How have you found the unbroken Light?
Without teeth, how can one chew iron?
Nanak, give us your true reflection." ॥19॥
(Guru:) "Born into the True Guru's house, my wandering ended.
My mind is attached to and imbued with the unstruck, ever-present Lord.
Through the Word I have burnt away hopes and desires;
turning to the Guru, I found the unbroken Light.
Erasing the three qualities, one chews the iron;
Nanak, the Saviour carries us across." ॥20॥
ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
(Siddhas:) "What do you say of the beginning? Where did the Absolute dwell then?
ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
What do you say are the earrings of spiritual wisdom? Who dwells in every heart?
ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ਠੀਗਾ. ਕਿਉ ਜਲਾਈਅਲੇ; ਕਿਉ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
How can the blow of Death be ended? How does one reach the home of fearlessness?
ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਆਸਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਕਿਉ. ਛੇਦੇ ਬੈਰਾਈਐ ॥
How does one know the seat of poise and contentment, and destroy the enemy?"
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ; ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
(Guru:) "Through the Guru's Word, one kills the poison of ego and dwells in one's own home.
ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੨੧॥
One who, through the Word, recognises the One who fashioned the creation — Nanak is his servant." ॥21॥
ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ. ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਵੈ; ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
(Siddhas:) "Where do we come from? Where do we go? Where do we remain absorbed?
ਏਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ, ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ. ਤਿਲੁ, ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
Whoever explains the meaning of this is a guru without the least greed.
ਕਿਉ ਤਤੈ ਅਵਿਗਤੈ ਪਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
How does one find the unmanifest essence? How does the one turned to the Guru come to love Him?
ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
He Himself is the Listener, He Himself the Creator; tell us your reflection, O Nanak."
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ. ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
(Guru:) "By His Command we come, by His Command we go, by His Command we remain absorbed.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
Through the Perfect Guru one lives the Truth; through the Word one knows His state and extent." ॥22॥
ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
"Of the beginning, only wonder can be told; the Absolute dwelt then, unbroken.
ਅਕਲਪਤ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ. ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਅਲੇ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ, ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
Know the earrings of spiritual wisdom to be the Guru's wisdom, free of desire; the True One dwells in every heart, in all beings.
ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ; ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Through the Guru's words one merges in the Unmanifest, and with ease finds the immaculate Essence.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ, ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੇਵੈ; ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Nanak, the Sikh who serves does no other work, and searching, he finds Him.
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Wondrous is His Command; one who recognises the Command knows the true way of life.
ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ. ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੩॥
One who erases self-conceit becomes detached; with the True One within, he alone is called a yogi." ॥23॥
ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਉਪਜੇ; ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
"From the unmanifest state the Immaculate One became manifest; from the formless He took form.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੀਆ ॥
Convinced by the True Guru, one attains the supreme state and is absorbed in the true Word.
ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਏਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
He knows the One alone as true, and has driven out ego and duality.
ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
He alone is a yogi who recognises the Guru's Word; the lotus within him has blossomed.
ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ. ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
When one dies while alive, he understands everything, and knows compassion for all within.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ; ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥੨੪॥
Nanak, he is blessed with glory, recognising himself in all beings." ॥24॥
ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ ॥
"Born of the True One, he merges in the True One; the true and pure become one with Him.
ਝੂਠੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਠਵਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
The false come and find no place of rest; in duality they come and go.
ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, coming and going is ended; the Lord Himself examines and forgives.
ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਆਪੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
Those who forget the Name, the source of all nectar, are afflicted by the one disease of duality.
